money_shots.what: The fence fires. At 35.1 NETWORK LOCATION flips green Canada/Toronto/WorldStream -> amber '× outside target — Claude blocked' / 5.201.242.113 / IR (IR) / Tehran / MCI, and in the SAME frame the TUI header flips 'Protected · target: Canada' -> 'Blocking Claude'. At 35.6 the menubar popover swings open reading 'Tower / Blocking Claude' with the blue toggle on and 'Usage paused — location not confirmed'.
money_shots.why: Three synchronized state changes in 0.5 s, then a 2.9 s stable hero card. Every word on screen is legible and on-message. Best single beat in the reel.
money_shots.crop: network_location + tui_header, then push out to full_frame at 35.6 for the popover

money_shots.what: Recovery. Header flips dim 'Reconnecting Claude…' -> green 'Protected · target: Canada' at 81.4, green '✓ allowed' rows push the red 'blocked' rows down and off, fully green by 82.4, allowed counter running 124178 -> 124188 -> 124200.
money_shots.why: The payoff frame for 'it resumes by itself'. Red-to-green wipe down a log is inherently satisfying and needs no narration.

money_shots.what: Cold-open payoff: at 8.9 five RED 'blocked Claude api.anthropic.com' rows are replaced in one frame by six GREEN '✓ allowed' rows all stamped 17:43:18, and the header goes 'Reconnecting Claude…' -> 'Protected'.
money_shots.why: Literally the 'PENDING, not FAILED' claim on screen — held requests all land at the same second. Single-frame flip, perfect for a hard cut or a 4x slow-mo.

money_shots.what: The inciting action: green 'Tap To Disconnect' -> grey 'Tap To Connect' + 'Disconnected!' toast at 19.1, with Tower still showing green Canada on the right.
money_shots.why: Clear human cause. Best framed two-up so the viewer holds 'nothing has happened to Tower yet' — then you cut to shot #1.

money_shots.why: Slow, readable accumulation — ideal for a slow push-in with a counter tick. Better than the static all-red run.

money_shots.why: Sets up the resolution; the contrast between a green button and a red log is a good tension frame.

off_pitch_flags.issue: No Claude Code session is ever on screen, so there is no 'Retrying · attempt x/y' spinner and no PENDING indicator anywhere. The core pitch ('requests go PENDING, never FAILED') has no direct on-screen proof — only Tower's own 'Reconnecting Claude…' header and the burst-of-allowed-rows moments at 8.9 and 81.4. Strongly consider re-shooting with a Claude Code terminal visible, or build the claim on the burst frames + a VO line.
AGENTS reads '0 at work' for all 87 s and the only agent row says 'done — your turn'. Nothing supports 'your agents keep working through the fault'.

14 s where NETWORK LOCATION already says '✓ inside target / Canada' but the guard is still blocking and the Blocked counter keeps climbing (21947 -> 21968). Reads as 'it's broken / stuck'. Either cut 68 -> 81, or cover it with a line about Claude's own retry backoff.

In the opening popover the guard toggle renders GREY (the popover window isn't key), so the hero card looks like the guard is OFF. Use the t=35.6-38.5 or t=49.6-51.3 popover (blue toggle) for any 'guard is on' frame.

First frame is an amber fault banner: 'Internet is slow — ping — — expect Claude timeouts'. Honest per project doctrine, but as a cold open it reads as 'this app is broken'. If you open here, the VO must immediately frame it as the app telling the truth.

PRIVACY: legible real data — public IPs 104.234.138.96 (Toronto, WorldStream B.V.) and 5.201.242.113 (Tehran, MCI); the V2Box config list with server names (WS-Mohammad_Sina-CDN / -DIRECT, HTTP-Mohammad_Sina-CDN-137.35GB) and partial IPs 185.****:443 / 37.3****:443; account quota '362.65 GB / 500 GB'; and spend figures 'Session $255 / Week $7307 / ~2.96B projected'. Blur or crop before publishing.

The brief expected NETWORK LOCATION 'outside target' to be RED; it is actually AMBER/olive. Only the LIVE TRAFFIC 'blocked' column is red. Any 'red means blocked' motion-graphics language should follow the amber/red split, not invent red.
Two popover openings last only ~0.4 s (4 frames at 10fps). They contain the best content (green 'Protected' + full plan bars at 25.0) but cannot be cut to at speed — freeze-frame or ramp.
A macOS screenshot thumbnail is parked at the right edge of the desktop (~x 2930-3032, y 380-580) and is labelled 'Screenshot 2026-0…3PM' — crop it out; it dates the footage.

Frontmost app bounces V2Box <-> Terminal; the inactive window's chrome greys out and the macOS menu bar text changes mid-shot. Avoid cuts that straddle a focus change unless you want the 'user clicked' read.
The mouse cursor sits as a text I-beam over the TUI in several otherwise-clean frames; a cursor-hide pass or a crop that excludes it would help.
